automationNotes: **Custom Hosting** path: verifies **Hosting Type** radio labels (**Hosting with Launch** / **Custom Hosting**), selects **Custom Hosting**, sets a sample **App URL**, and clicks **Save** (doc **Save** on Hosting). Docs also describe Hosting with Launch; this flow does not create Launch projects.
